notes.subject: Oregon restriction / Kristy 2026 call notes
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Bend Summer Festival / Lay It Out Events, vendors@layitoutevents.com, 541-323-0964. Notes say Kristy called, talked with the secretary, and events coordinator Ty sent information May 7, 2026. Oregon is NOT a territory hold. Oregon and Washington are restricted because of weather: prepaid bookings are preferred. Pay-for-play may still be considered when specifically approved; for Hulk's post-Labor-Day routing, pay-for-play in Oregon or Washington is allowed when it makes sense because he is already traveling back through the area. Source: handwritten call notes, page 78, plus updated booking rule confirmed Aug. 27, 2026.
